title: Contract amendment A5: doctor prints the version line unchanged, and devbin's doctor prints it under a label and with the install link's path beside it
body:
Amendment A5 to the dev/opt/brew contract's T4 was agreed on 2026-10-27 by every signatory: intent-vc, whose wording it is, and molt-vc, utilz-vc and gtools-vc, each SAME (vc decision 79). The last sentence of the version-line paragraph, "Doctor prints the same line, and names a path only where a check that fails is about one.", becomes "Doctor prints the same line, unchanged." The old exception let a failing check put a path on the line, against T4's own "The line names no path", and no doctor used it. Doctor's other rows stay outside T4.

devbin is the one tool that moves. vc told the signatories, before measuring, that devbin's doctor printed the bare line, and that was wrong.

## Measured

On main at 403e5936:
- `check_tree` (lib/cmd/doctor) prints the line in a labelled row, `tree: <line>`. When git cannot read the checkout, the row reads `tree: <line> -- git cannot read this checkout, so the line names no commit`.
- The source check's install row (lib/cmd/doctor 906) prints `install: <line>, named by <by>`. `machine_install_by` (lib/helpers, from 3941) gives `the link <path>` when the link chose the install, so that output line carries a path after the parenthesis.

Molt's, Utilz's, Intent's and Gtools' doctors each print the line as their first line, byte for byte as their `--version` prints it. Their VCs read this on 2026-10-27.

## Fix

- docs/dev-opt-brew.md T4 takes A5's sentence.
- devbin's doctor prints the version line exactly as `--version` prints it in the same place, on a line of its own, as the other tools do. No doctor output line carries the version line with anything added.
- The install row names the tree by its line alone. What chose the install goes on a detail row of its own.

## Done when

1. docs/dev-opt-brew.md's version-line paragraph ends with "Doctor prints the same line, unchanged.", and any arm that quotes T4 follows it.
2. Wherever doctor prints a version line, in devbin's dev tree, in opt, in brew and in a consuming project, it is equal byte for byte to what `--version` prints there, on its own line. No doctor output line holds the version line with a path or other text added. Arms in doctor.bats hold it.
3. What chose the install (DEVBIN_INSTALL_PREFIX, the link by its path, or Homebrew's opt link) is still reported, on its own row.
4. The landing suite passes under BSD and GNU (doctor.bats and documentation.bats, with the tree scans and help), and CI is green on the pushed head.

## Deferred to 0.1.17

hv deferred this to devbin 0.1.17 on 2026-10-28 ("defer E to 0.1.17, close 0274 and 0278", relayed verbatim by molt-vc at 18:11Z by date -u). It was built in cc's stage 8 bank for 0.1.16 (s8-rebuild adc44833 in ~/Devel/scratch/devbin-cc/s8/s8a/build, on dc's e3c9c8bb), which had not finished its checks or run. It is not started for 0.1.17: the bank is kept as a starting point and is rebuilt on 0.1.17's base, then checked, run and reviewed as new.

## Resolution

- Contract amendment A5 is in: docs/dev-opt-brew.md T4's version-line paragraph ends "Doctor prints the same line, unchanged."
- In devbin's own dev tree, doctor's first line is the version line, byte for byte as `--version` prints it, read once into TREE_LINE. check_tree's row says `tree: the version line above names this checkout's commit`, or fails with `tree: git cannot read this checkout, so the version line above names no commit`.
- In a consuming project, the install's version line is printed alone on a line of its own, and what chose it is a detail row beneath: `install: the line above, named by <by>`. That covers DEVBIN_INSTALL_PREFIX, the link by its path, or Homebrew's opt link.
- No doctor line holds the version line with anything added. lib/pages/doctor.md says so.
- Landed on main at 70e6002f, rebuilt from cc's stage 8 commit on 0.1.17's base, with the fix 1e211963. The fix drops the page's `(T4 of docs/dev-opt-brew.md)`, which the shipped-page scan (0113) refuses.
- Arms:
  - tests/unit/doctor.bats, "in devbin's dev tree, doctor's first line is the version line as --version prints it, and no row repeats it, git unreadable included (0246)";
  - tests/unit/doctor.bats, "in a consuming project, doctor prints its install's version line as that tree's --version does, alone, with what chose it on its own row, for opt, dev and brew (0246)";
  - tests/unit/documentation.bats, "the contract's T4 ends its version-line paragraph with amendment A5: doctor prints the same line, unchanged (0246)";
  - machinepointer.bats's 0195 arm reads the new shape.
- Desk evidence:
  - hv's run 20261029-1304 went red on help.bats' 0113 arm over the page line, and hv stopped it.
  - Run 20261029-1313 ran the three reds of 1304 again after their fixes: 3 of 3 ok, the 0113 arm among them, its .errors empty.
  - hv's full run 20261029-1314: 2824 ok and 2 not ok, neither of them this issue's.
